mission: General-purpose language model distinguished by efficient understanding and reasoning across supplied long context; no permanent lab model-size ceiling.

flagship.shape_binding: Expand retained flagship geometry using the frozen tokenizer and validate instantiated parameters before launch; reference count is inherited analytic accounting, not a new measurement.

lengths.reporting: Report allocated, trained, effective and hardware-usable lengths separately for every released checkpoint.

product.response_policy: Useful concise answers by default; effort/response mode selected in bounded post-training development, with answer quality and output cost measured. No thinking-only commitment.

architecture_change_rule: Keep the inherited hybrid fixed. Matched dense is a scientific control. Critical correctness or hardware failure may require a separately costed successor before training; no automatic operator search or silent switch to dense.
release_artifacts: two held-out demonstrations and reproducible evaluation
optional_artifacts: GGUF/CPU after recurrent backend parity and budget qualification
